title: Report a problem

link.will: We will attach a short link to this page. It opens without signing in, everything masked.
link.none: This page has no short link: only the description will be sent.
link.down: A short link cannot be created now, the database is unavailable: only the description will be sent.

sent.title: Message sent

failure.rateLimited: Too many messages. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
failure.keep: Your text stays in the form: you can copy it and pass it to support.
